texte.L'utilisateur utilise le Simulateur de d: The user is using the AI Act deployment simulator (Decision support page). Classification engine based on Art. # (prohibited practices), Art. #(#) + Annex III (high-risk), Art. # (transparency, limited risk), Art. #-# (GPAI). Penalties calculated under Art. # according to turnover. Obligations detailed article by article with compliance status.
texte.L'évaluation automatisée doit rester con: Automated assessment must remain open to challenge
texte.LLM, scoring, vision, RAG, SaaS tiers, g: LLM, scoring, vision, RAG, third-party SaaS, content generator…
texte.La barre du haut suit le défilement et m: The top bar follows the scroll and marks the section you are in — eleven entries, from the map to the sources, including “Siting choice”, “Envelope & DPGF” and “Outlook #-#”. Each tab carries the COLOUR OF ITS FAMILY, even at rest: blue to observe, turquoise to understand, brown to verify — the family is visible before the word is read. Hovering, or moving through with the keyboard, shows what the section contains. It announces the size of what waits behind each link, works from the keyboard, and each link is a real address: copy it to send a colleague straight to the right section.
texte.La bascule du repère au calcul — le réfé: The switch from reference to calculation — the framework positions you, this module quantifies what you are answerable for.
texte.La base de connaissance n’est pas config: The knowledge base is not configured on this server: the variable
texte.La base légale est le champ le plus souv: The legal basis is the field most often filled in wrongly, and the first one checked. “Consent” presupposes freely given, informed and revocable consent; “legitimate interest” presupposes a documented balancing test. A processing activity without a valid legal basis cannot be fixed with documentation.
texte.La capitalisation d’expertise du cabinet: This is where the firm’s build-up of expertise lies: the second scoping costs half as much as the first — provided the first one left a trace.
texte.La carte dit ce que # % NE veut PAS dire: The map says what # % does NOT mean here: the framework is not certified, there is no auditor at the end. A full rate means “everything is filled in and kept up”, not “compliant”.
texte.La carte du dispositif avant d’en parcou: The map of the framework before you walk one branch of it — without it, each module looks like an isolated obligation instead of a link in the chain.
texte.La carte et le tableau sont synchronisés: The map and the table are synchronised. Click a jurisdiction to see its details. The 🤖 Refresh via AI button queries Mistral/Claude to check the current regulatory status.
texte.La carte réglementaire dit où l’IA est e: The regulatory map says where AI is regulated; this one says where it is produced: notable models by country, flows of elite researchers (NeurIPS), patents granted, adoption by European companies.
texte.La classe commande la procédure, donc le: The class drives the procedure, and therefore the budget and the timetable.
texte.La classe vous dit si un organisme notif: The class tells you whether a notified body had to be involved — and therefore what you should see in the file.
texte.La colonne « source » ci-dessous n’est p: The “source” column below is not a choice made by whoever enters the data: an indicator
texte.La concentration se lit sur la carte, pa: Concentration is read on the map, not in a single site’s file: several offtakers may depend on the same grid connection point.
texte.La conformité doit tenir sans équipe déd: Compliance has to hold without a dedicated team: a register kept by hand, a single supplier, an annual review. A framework calibrated for a large account will not be applied.
texte.La conformité à l’article # du Règlement: Compliance with Article # of the Regulation.
texte.La connexion s est interrompue pendant l: The connection was interrupted during the import: no response was
texte.La correspondance n’a de sens que dans u: The correspondence only makes sense within a declared regime.
texte.La deuxième promotion coûte la moitié de: The second cohort costs half as much as the first — provided the first left a trace somewhere other than in the trainer’s memory.
texte.La direction doit démontrer son engageme: Senior management must demonstrate its commitment to the AIMS, establish an AI policy, and clearly assign roles and responsibilities for AI governance.
texte.La directive #/# impose d'informer le co: Directive #/# requires the consumer to be informed when the price displayed is personalised by automated processing. It is a display obligation, not an internal governance one.
texte.La discipline, elle, est la même : reten: The discipline, however, is the same: include or exclude, and justify in both cases.
texte.La distinction entre l’empreinte d’usage: The distinction between the usage footprint and the total footprint — and why a grey country is not a country at zero.
texte.La distinction essentielle / importante: The essential / important distinction stops being a matter of supervision: it removes five of the twenty objectives for an important entity, and takes the expected means from # to #.
texte.La documentation technique doit alors dé: The technical documentation must then describe the development process, including methods and tools (Art. # and Annex IV). An unwritten assisted-development policy becomes a missing document in the file, which can be established during the conformity assessment.
texte.La documentation, au même endroit pour t: Documentation, in the same place for everyone
The decision could not be saved.
texte.La dépense réelle par système, calculée: Actual spend per system, calculated on a volume you have declared — never estimated on your behalf.
Actual spend per system, calculated on your volumes — and the share of the estate that remains unexamined, stated in plain words.
texte.La détection de port d'EPI observe des p: PPE detection continuously observes identifiable people. GDPR, informing staff representatives — and Annex III, point # as soon as the images are used to assess behaviour.
texte.La fin des compétences « portées par tou: The end of skills “held by everyone”, that is, by no one.
texte.La finalité est requise : une demande sa: The purpose is required: a request without a written purpose is not examined.
texte.La fonction soutenue est-elle critique o: Is the supported function critical or
texte.La formation des dirigeants est l’obliga: Training for managers is the obligation, training for staff the encouragement. A company that trains all its teams except its board has missed the only one of the two that exposes it personally.
texte.La frontière que les rapports confondent: The boundary reports most often blur: what you consume, and what the service you use consumes.
texte.La liste nominative des destinataires ex: The named list of recipients exists, and each of them has opened the tool at least once.
texte.La liste porte un millésime, et celui-ci: The list carries an edition, and it could NOT be cross-checked against the online publication from the build machine: reopen top#.owasp.org before presenting it.
texte.La mesure d’usage posée AVANT la général: The usage measurement set BEFORE the roll-out to everyone: a dated starting point, a written method, a named cohort.
texte.La mesure f) exige d’évaluer l’EFFICACIT: Measure f) requires assessing the EFFECTIVENESS of the measures, not just their existence.
texte.La moitié du sujet que les indicateurs d: The half of the subject that compliance indicators do not see: actual use.
texte.La molette agrandit et réduit sans touch: The scroll wheel zooms in and out without holding a key; the hand pans as soon as the map is zoomed in, and both work together. The “Go to” field accepts a country, an organisation or a data centre. Double-click a country: the map reaches it at the last zoom level. The bottom bar controls the data centre layer and the #-# horizon — the slider fades the sites whose announced commissioning date is later than the date chosen, and that is how the trajectory of the estate is read. The legend opens from the button on the right.
texte.La molette agrandit et réduit, sans touc: The scroll wheel zooms in and out, without holding a key; the hand pans as soon as the map is zoomed in, and both work at the same time. The “Go to” field takes you straight to a country. Double-click a country: immediate details. Zooming does not just enlarge — at each level the map shows what it could not write at a smaller size: volumes, then the codes of countries without a model, then the callout for the country targeted.
texte.La moyenne d’un parc hétérogène ne désig: The average of a heterogeneous estate designates no real site. A decision taken on it ends up concerning a facility that does not exist.
texte.La nature de chaque valeur — publié, sit: The nature of each value — published, site, class — written in black and white, which is exactly what an auditor will ask for.
texte.La nomenclature NACE Rév. # compte # sec: The NACE Rev. # classification has # sections, and # sector profiles cover all of them. The distinction that matters is no longer “covered or not”; it lies elsewhere: # profiles carry an OBSERVED baseline — a starting point observed in organisations in the sector, with budget and duration drawn from real engagements — and they cover # sections. The # others carry a REGIME read from the texts (Annex III of Regulation (EU) #/#, Annexes I and II of Directive (EU) #/#) but no baseline, no budget, no duration, and they say so in the list as on the record. Previously these # sections had NO profile, and the audit displayed was then the one for the previous sector: a client in construction read the telecoms audit with nothing to contradict it. The audit remains complete in every case: the # pillars, the questionnaire, the # phases and the deliverables do not depend on the sector — it is your answers that set the starting point.
texte.La notification part SIMULTANÉMENT au CS: The notification goes SIMULTANEOUSLY to the coordinating CSIRT and to ENISA, through the single platform of Article #. Alerting one and then the other is not what the text requires.
texte.La page se pré-remplit automatiquement a: The page pre-fills automatically with the active sector, the actual number of systems in the AI register (weighted by their classification) and the current AI Act audit score of the prospect/client.
texte.La part variable du modèle hybride est a: The variable share of the hybrid model is automatically capped at #× the fixed base — if this cap is reached, a (capped) badge appears in the results. It is no longer just a written recommendation: it is built into the calculation.
texte.La passerelle a coupé avant la fin du tr: The gateway cut off before processing finished: the extraction took longer
texte.La personne concernée par une décision p: A data subject affected by a decision producing legal effects or significantly affecting them can obtain clear explanations of the role of the system in that decision.
texte.La personne peut-elle contester et obten: Can the person challenge the decision and obtain a review?
texte.La planification des modifications n’exi: Planning of changes did not exist in the old structure: it is the only new clause in the body of the standard.
texte.La pondération vient de votre secteur: The weighting comes from your sector
texte.La première étape que vous n’avez pas en: The first step you have not yet
texte.La probabilité de défaillance que vous p: The likelihood of failure you will enter in the matrix stops being a hunch: it rests on a measured baseline.
texte.La progression mensuelle simulée dépend: The simulated monthly progress depends on the sector selected and on the actual reference organisational maturity (score from the AI maturity audit) — an IT sector generally progresses faster than a Health or Energy sector, for example.
texte.La protection des données est réexaminée: Data protection is re-examined at every change
texte.La qualification dépend du Registre: The qualification depends on the register
texte.La qualification d’un système au sens de: The qualification of a system under the AI Act
texte.La qualification ne se demande pas : l’É: Qualification is not requested: the State draws up the list and the entity declares itself on it, no later than # April #. That date has passed. An unregistered entity is not “not yet concerned”: it is in breach of an obligation whose deadline is behind it.
texte.La qualité et la gouvernance des données: Data quality and governance are the invis
Data quality and governance are the invisible foundation of any AI compliance — this path focuses on them.
texte.La question qu’aucun tableau de coûts ne: The question no cost table asks on its own — a stable line item whose use collapses is a renewal to refuse.
texte.La recommandation CNIL du # mai # rappel: The CNIL recommendation of # May # points out that when a score leads to granting or refusing credit without meaningful human intervention, Article # must be analysed. The reasoning applies beyond credit: insurance, fraud, customer rating, access to a service.
texte.La restriction la plus facile à tenir, e: The easiest restriction to keep, and the one that pays off least. Beware of false comfort: a generated test that tests nothing lets through what it was meant to catch, and nobody notices until something breaks.
texte.La revue de sécurité d’un composant expo: The security review of an exposed component
texte.La revue habituelle reste entière ; ces: The usual review remains complete; these seven points are added to it, each one because a model fails differently from a person.
texte.La revue à quatre-vingt-dix jours a eu l: The ninety-day review has taken place and its drop-out rate has been recorded — the wave does not end at deployment.
texte.La règle la plus simple et la plus clair: The simplest and clearest rule. It assumes that producing assisted code takes the same commitment as writing it — and therefore that review time is counted as working time, not taken out of the announced gain.
texte.La réponse à la question que l’indice de: The answer to the question the compliance index does not ask: is the framework used? The two fail separately — you can be perfectly compliant on paper and have no actual use.
texte.La révision # (#) parle d’ICS et surchar: Revision # (#) speaks of ICS and overlays #-# Rev. #; revision # (#) speaks of OT and targets revision #. The two do not cover the same catalogue. Nothing is certified against #-#, and this module does not copy IEC #, to which the overlay refers.
texte.La révision # s’applique depuis le #er j: Revision # has applied since # January # and redistributes the letters from G onwards. Finance has moved from K to L, IT and telecommunications now occupy K, education Q, health R, and a section V has been created. Each section shows what its letter designated before: in front of “L — financial activities”, a reader who knows revision # would otherwise think it an error.
texte.La section Sources liste chaque constant: The Sources section lists every constant in the model — intensities, PUE, WUE, load factor, templates, water and price classes — with its publisher, its edition and its link, plus the register of fact checks: # claims checked against the sources, verdict by verdict, including past corrections. The framework is versioned at the top of the page: always cite the version and the date. The verification dots in the text open on hover.
texte.La section U vise les ménages en tant qu: Section U covers households as employers. A private individual is not the subject of an AI governance audit. The entity that is, is the agent, the platform or the service provider that operates the systems on their behalf.
texte.La section désigne des MÉNAGES : l'entit: The section designates HOUSEHOLDS: the auditable entity is elsewhere
texte.La section « Implantation » compare les: The “Siting” section compares countries against SEVEN criteria, each with its nature and its source: carbon intensity, dispatchability of the mix (nuclear, renewables, fossil — # generation), water availability (the EEA’s WEI+ index, with the share of agricultural irrigation: where crops withdraw more than half of the water, evaporative cooling competes for use in summer), free-cooling potential, industrial electricity price in Eurostat classes, estate in service, and #-# connection queue counted from our statuses. Set the WEIGHT of each criterion (# to #) according to your project: the ranking is recalculated before your eyes, and the formula displayed is the formula executed — on the server side. The result is ALSO placed on the MAP of the Union, in the same projection and with the same outlines as the panel map — the geography only has to be learnt once. A Sweden / Finland / Norway podium and a Spain / Italy / Greece podium have the same ranks and do not say the same thing: one sends you north, the other south, and the map shows it at a glance. Two points to remember: the colours come from the WEIGHTS you have just set, they are not a property of the framework; and a grey country is not poorly rated, it is ABSENT from the framework — the legend says so in plain words, because on a coloured map grey is spontaneously read as a poor result. Filtering the grid does not empty the map: it keeps all of rated Europe, otherwise it would lose what justifies it, the comparison.
